Heard learned counsel for petitioner and learned A.G.A. for State.

Present writ petition is filed by petitioner for the following primary reliefs:-
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the opposite parties 2 to 5 to decide the representation dated 10.12.2024 and 28.12.2024 of the petitioner and take necessary action against opposite party no.8 (Balji Pal) and Raj Kamal Pal vs State Of U.P. 1 Opposite Party No.9 Sri Dharmendra Singh, then Tehsildar, Tehsil-Kunda,
District-Pratapgarh and other related employees and increased the section under the Schedule Caste provided as per law in the Constitution of India in the interest of justice.

(ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding and directing the Opposite Parties 2 to 4 to transfer the First Information Report No.0229 dated 07.11.2024 under Section 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station-Mankipur, District-Pratapgarh to other District in the interest of justice."
Learned A.G.A. on instructions states that in this case during course of investigation Sections 467,
468, 471 I.P.C. have been dropped and charge-sheet under Section 420 I.P.C. has been filed before the supervisory authority on 23.12.2024 and the same is pending for consideration.
Learned counsel for petitioner prays that he may be permitted to take appropriate remedy against the charge-sheet before the supervisory authority.
If petitioner has any grievance in respect of charge-sheet, petitioner can express it by way of application before the supervisory authority within a period of ten days' from today, who shall consider the same and take decision in the matter in accordance with law, within a period of three weeks thereafter.
With the aforesaid, the writ petition is disposed of.
Order Date :- 10.1.2025 Arti/-
[Om Prakash Shukla,J.] [Vivek Chaudhary,J.]
